name: dsv41-ladder
description: servebench (spark-ds41f 2d2b2328, vendored unmodified in bench/servebench) as Christopher Owen runs it, for this recipe's concurrency ladder and the MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS x CED-skip sweep: closed loops at 16, 8, 4, 2 and 1 streams over the 256 distinct prompts (a fresh cache salt per request, exactly 256 output tokens, greedy, thinking off; 60 s warm-up, 300 s measured, the release suite's c16/c8 and single-stream's c1 arguments), then real-text cold prefill with the release suite's sizes without 1M (same seeds, so the same documents as his release runs at 32K-512K) and a short-prompt step at 8K and 16K, where the chunk count changes across the sweep. No engine grid: production servers do not expose the dev-mode RPC.
